decisions.reason: Semantic top-1 API is unrelated to SMS webhooks; LLM choice is relevant but does not retrieve webhooks, only delivery status, so no clear better match.
LLM choice matches semantic top-1; both use Wavecell SMS delivery status API which does not provide LINE message content, so no better match.
LLM choice provides categories potentially useful for birthday message suggestions, better matching the step than unrelated finance API.
